Created a working Maven Spring Boot 4.1.1 / Java 21 JPA project:

```
pom.xml                                              spring-boot-starter-data-jpa + H2 + tests
src/main/java/com/example/demo/DemoApplication.java  @SpringBootApplication
src/main/java/com/example/demo/Customer.java         @Entity
src/main/java/com/example/demo/CustomerRepository.java  extends JpaRepository
src/main/resources/application.properties            H2 datasource + Hibernate
src/test/java/com/example/demo/CustomerRepositoryTest.java  @DataJpaTest
.gitignore
```

Verified with `mvn test`: `BUILD SUCCESS`, 1 test passing (save + `findByLastName` + `findById`). Run `mvn spring-boot:run` to start; swap the H2 datasource for your real DB driver in `application.properties`.
